THE DESTRUCTOR PAIR IS DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED, AND NOT FOR THE USUAL REASON. The cartridge orders them D1 (0x0211f000) then D0 (0x0211f0a0), which is the REPRODUCIBLE direction -- measured here on mwccarm 2004/b56, an inline in-class `virtual ~Goomboss() {}` emits the pair with no D2, while an out-of-line definition emits D2 (0xa0), D0 (0xb4), D1 (0xa0) in that section order. The blocker is the KEY FUNCTION. With the destructor inline the key function becomes the first out-of-line virtual the class declares, Behavior at 0x02121bf0, which is on the far side of the near-miss hole. A TU that does not own the key function emits no vtable, and with no vtable nothing odr-uses the destructor, so neither variant is emitted at all (measured: a probe TU over the inline-destructor header emits zero symbols beyond its own function). A forcing scaffold does emit the pair, and in ROM order when `delete p;` precedes `p->~Goomboss();` -- the variants come out in reverse order of first odr-use, measured here and recorded in no role file -- but mwccarm emits the scaffold itself into .text immediately BELOW D1, and D1 sits at 0x0211f000, the first byte of ov074's .text. There is no address below it. src/_ZN8GoombossD1Ev.cpp and src/_ZN8GoombossD0Ev.cpp therefore keep their own delinks entries and this object emits no copy of either.

THE ONE THING BETWEEN 36 AND 55 IS func_ov074_02121380. Match it and the hole closes, a single TU owns Behavior and therefore the key function, the vtable and both destructors come with it, and the whole 0x0211f000..0x0212290c run promotes. notes/mwccarm-codegen.md 6bq records the levers already tried and calls it one lever short.

The manifest is text-only. _ZTV8Goomboss (ov074:0x02122eb8, 31 slots, 0x7c symbol extent / 0x84 storage) and the whole dEnemyBase_c -> dActor_c -> dBase_c -> fBase_c vague-linkage chain are NOT emitted by this object at all, because the licensed range excludes the key function; there is nothing to deadstrip but Vector3's inline destructor. `externalized_output` is absent -- no symbol needed the canonical-import route.

The row count was MEASURED, not inherited: ov074 had no sibling oracle. A probe TU that owns the key function emits exactly 11 data symbols -- _ZTV8Goomboss plus _ZTI/_ZTS for Goomboss, dEnemyBase_c, dActor_c, dBase_c and fBase_c -- which is 2 x 5 levels + 1 vtable, the formula's prediction, exact.
